Title: Under the Stars

Cast

1. अर्जुन - 34 years, friend
Look: cream shirt, brown boots
2. कबीर - 33 years, friend
Look: blue jacket, jeans
3. समीर - 32 years, friend
Look: brown sweater, a woollen scarf

Places

1. the forest camp - tall pine trees, a small orange tent, a clearing with soft grass
2. the lake shore - still water, round stones, a wooden jetty

Objects

1. tent - a small orange tent
2. guitar - an old wooden guitar
3. kettle - a black metal kettle

Script begins

Scene 1 - the forest camp - Night

[अर्जुन lights the campfire. Sparks fly up into the dark sky.]

[कबीर sits by the fire and plays the guitar. समीर warms his hands.]

समीर (shivering): "It's so cold tonight! Play something warm, कबीर."

कबीर (laughing): "Warm songs? I only know sad ones!"

[The moon rises over the trees. The sky fills with stars.]

[अर्जुन lies on his back on the grass and looks up at the stars.]

अर्जुन (softly): "Look up. Have you ever seen so many stars?"

Scene 2 - the forest camp - Late night

[The fire burns low. समीर is asleep in the tent. कबीर yawns and stretches.]

कबीर (sleepily): "Good night."

[कबीर crawls into the tent and falls asleep next to समीर.]

Scene 3 - the lake shore - Early morning

[Thick mist hangs over the lake. The three friends walk side by side down to the water.]

[The sun rises slowly behind the hills and the mist begins to fade.]

समीर (surprised): "Wow! The whole lake is turning gold!"

[अर्जुन pours tea from the kettle into three cups.]

अर्जुन (smiling): "Tea with a sunrise.
Best breakfast in the world."
